rules: Civilian and non-combat roles are first-class generation outcomes.
Operator/civilization changes valid technology, organization and design grammar rather than merely presentation skin.
A generated ship must have a plausible reason to exist at its generated location.
Technology must be valid for date, operator and design.
A generated ship may begin with wear, damage, shortages or unusual configuration only when generation context justifies it.
Crew/population generation follows the ship's functional staffing needs.
Canonical ship identities are reserved and cannot be procedurally duplicated.
Generated design and generated individual ship are separate persistent identities.
Individual ship watch/life state is generated after staffing requirements and before NPC schedules.
A generated vessel receives a shipboard life profile appropriate to class/configuration/operator and mission.
The generator must expose vacancies/understaffing rather than silently creating extra crew.
